Not every AI agent should have the same autonomy. Martin Keen explains four AI agent loops: interactive, delegated, scheduled, and event-driven. Learn how goals, triggers, stopping conditions, and human review shape each agentic workflow.

 00:00 – Understand How AI Agent Loops Work
 00:19 – Follow the Goal, Act, Observe & Adjust Cycle
 01:12 – Decide Who Controls the AI Agent Loop
 01:31 – Use Interactive Loops for Human-Led Tasks
 03:30 – Delegate Stopping Conditions to AI
 05:17 – Schedule Recurring AI Agent Workflows
 06:40 – Trigger AI Agent Loops with Events
 07:15 – Review AI Work with a Second Agent
 08:01 – Escalate Agent Exceptions to Humans
 08:32 – Compare the 4 Types of AI Agent Loops
